summary: Full resolution of Codex Review R1-R4 for DRIVE-01-F06: (R1) Total elimination of off-budget retained unreserved handles via pre-admission in executeOpen, strictly bounding retainedFailedResources.size() <= pendingCleanupObligations <= cleanupQueueCapacity; verified by new adversarial repro test suite DriveUnreservedLifecycleReproTest.java; (R2) Exported comprehensive unified patch DRIVE_01_F06.patch across 21 modified and untracked files with clean isolated worktree reconstruction matching 100% bit-for-bit SHA-256 hashes and building 16/16 tests independently; (R3) Built persistent snapshot demo database and verified ordinary browser playback on http://localhost:3000/movies/drive-videoplayback without CDP API URL rewriting, observing cold start 19.2s, frame rendering at readyState 4, seek in 13.0s, and pause; (R4) Integrated live fine-tuned Qwen3-4B + Phase 23 LoRA on RTX 3050 CUDA GPU via Next.js :3000 -> FastAPI :8000 -> UI, and secured fresh independent audit PASS sign-off from Agent E against final file hashes; all background services and mounts cleanly stopped.

R1_failedUnreservedHandles.finding: In F05, unreserved executeOpen and worker close allowed retained resources without charging pending (chargesPending=false), leaking off-budget retained handles outside advertised active+pending counters.
R1_failedUnreservedHandles.resolution: Enforced composite lifecycle pre-admission in executeOpen (effectiveReservation = isInternalReservation ? acquireReservation() : reservation). Saturated capacity is rejected fail-fast at admission before opening any resource. Every retained failed cleanup unconditionally charges pending (chargesPending=true). Fixed shutdown drain guard in executeCleanupAsync (cleanupExecutor.isShutdown()).
R1_failedUnreservedHandles.tests: DriveUnreservedLifecycleReproTest (3/3 PASS), LunaDriveCleanupOpenLifecycleTest (7/7 PASS), LunaDriveCleanupShutdownOwnershipTest (6/6 PASS)

R2_patchReproducibility.finding: DRIVE_01_F05.patch contained only nine diff headers and omitted LunaDriveCleanupOpenLifecycleTest, LunaDriveCleanupShutdownOwnershipTest, and MockMaker.
R2_patchReproducibility.resolution: Exported DRIVE_01_F06.patch with 21 diff headers encompassing all production code, tests, MockMaker, scripts, and runbooks. Clean reconstruction in isolated worktree at base commit fe55916 verified 21/21 files 100% SHA-256 match and passed 16/16 Maven tests independently.

R3_usableSnapshotAndBrowserPlayback.finding: Existing reviewer harness started transient H2, seeded synthetic movie mapping, and rewrote API URLs through Chrome CDP.
R3_usableSnapshotAndBrowserPlayback.resolution: Configured persistent H2 demo DB (./data/moviercm_db) and repeatable Drive movie mapping in DataInitializer.java (drive-videoplayback -> videoplayback.mp4, 29209556 bytes). Executed test_live_browser_f06.cjs via real Chrome headless without CDP API rewriting. Verified play (cold start 19.2s, readyState 4), seek (13.0s), and pause.

R4_independentAuditSignOffAndRealism.finding: F05 cross-review cited obsolete audit reviewing in-progress hash dd44e84d... rather than final source. Report overclaimed instant seeks and WCAG conformance.
R4_independentAuditSignOffAndRealism.resolution: Fresh independent audit performed by Agent E against final source hashes (DA43127F... in DriveIoExecutor), resulting in unconditional PASS across all 4 criteria. Truthfully reported measured WAN cold start ~11-19s, seek ~11-14s, container video-only DASH stream nature, and RAM buffering.
